IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE STATE OF OREGON
FOR MULTNOMAH COUNTY
I·e,the matter of Preventative PRESIDING JUDGE ORDER
2101-30000
􀁠etention Determinations and
Security Release in Cases Subject ORDER RE PREVENTATIVE
DETENTION HEARING
PROCEDURES AND SECURITY
RELEASE IN VIOLENT
FELONIES
ORS 135.240(2) to (4) and

ORs 135.240(6)
ORS 135.240(2) to (4) and ORS 135.240(6) provide for denial of pretrial release in
certain cases for individuals charged with violent felonies. This order describes the
procedures for determining preventative detention in charges subject to ORS 135.240(2}
to (4) and ORS 135.240(6). This order does not affect any procedure for any other charges
in the same or any other charging instrument related to the defendant if the charges are
not subject to this order.
For the crimes of Aggravated Murder, Murder in the First Degree, Murder in the
Second Degree, and Treason, the decision whether to set a security amount will be
deferred pending a hearing pursuant to the procedures set forth in ORS 135.240(2) to (4).
Until that time, the charge will be listed as "security decision deferred/no release."
The charges listed below are considered to be violent felonies for purposes of ORS
135.240(6) based on the charging instrument. For those charges, the decision whether to
set a security amount will be deferred pending further hearing pursuant to the
procedures set forth in ORS 135.240(4) (hereinafter Preventative Detention Hearing) or
other court order. Until that time, the charge will be listed as "security decision
deferred/no release."
• Any felony included in ORS 163A.005(5} (felony sex crimes)
• Manslaughter in the First Degree under ORS 163.118
• Manslaughter in the Second Degree under ORS 163.125
• Criminally Negligent Homicide under ORS 163.145
• Assault in the First Degree under ORS 163.185(1)(a), (b), or (d)
• Attempted Assault in the First Degree under ORS 163.185(a) or (b), or under ORS
163.185(d) if the person is accused of acting intentionally
• Assault in the Second Degree under ORS 163.175(1)(a) or (c)
